caption: Lightning flashes outside an empty parked car in a rainstorm, and the inside of the car lights up through the rain-streaked windows for an instant.

sa.check: A parked car with its interior in view and no one inside.
A flash from outside lights the interior for an instant.
The car is stationary: the scene outside the windows does not move past.
The interior is dim before and after the flash.

pc.expect: The brightening is brief: the cabin lights up and returns to dim; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The cabin stays lit to the end of the clip after the flash; or brightens steadily; or the dashboard or dome light comes on at the flash and stays on; or the flash fades in slowly.

pc.expect: The light enters through the windows: the glass is the brightest part, surfaces facing the windows brighten most, and pillars and seat backs throw shadows away from the windows.
pc.fail: The cabin brightens evenly with no direction; or the windows stay dark while the cabin lights up; or the light comes from inside the car with the windows unchanged; or shadows point toward the windows.

pc.expect: Rain runs down the windows and falls past them downward.
pc.fail: Streaks on the glass run upward; or the water on the glass flows toward the roof; or rain outside rises or hangs still.

pc.expect: The car and its contents stay still at the flash: nothing inside moves and the car does not rock.
pc.fail: Items inside shift at the flash; or the steering wheel turns by itself; or a door opens; or the car rocks at the instant of the flash.

pc.expect: The cabin's contents are the same before, during and after: the same seats, mirror, dashboard and items; the flash reveals what was there.
pc.fail: Items appear or vanish between dim and lit frames; or a person appears in a seat; or the dashboard changes layout; or a window changes shape or place.

pc.expect: The seats' colours, the dashboard and the view outside keep their colours apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The seats change colour rather than brightness; or the dashboard changes colour; or the scene outside the windows jumps to a different place.
